summary.text: Fred Davis Jr. is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 3 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the New Hampshire House from 2018 to 2020 and has served as moderator of Nashua Ward 4.

paragraphs.text: Fred Davis Jr. was born in Peterborough, New Hampshire, and graduated from Biddeford High School in 1980.
He has served as the moderator of Nashua Ward 4.
Davis represented Hillsborough 31 in the New Hampshire House from 2018 to 2020, and he assumed his current seat representing Hillsborough 3 on December 7, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists him on the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee for 2023-2024 and on the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee for 2019-2020.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
